en.name: Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS)
en.shortDescription: Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) — acute, severe, diffuse lung injury causing hypoxaemic respiratory failure.
en.longDescription:
## Definition & Clinical Context

Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) is acute, diffuse inflammatory lung injury causing severe hypoxaemic respiratory failure with bilateral pulmonary infiltrates not fully explained by cardiac failure. It is a defining condition of intensive care, typically requiring mechanical ventilation, and is triggered by pneumonia, sepsis, aspiration, trauma and other insults.

## Scope

The set is anchored on the SNOMED concept *4195694 / 67782005 — Acute respiratory distress syndrome*. It captures the diagnosis of ARDS as an acute critical-illness condition.

## Mapping Notes

- ARDS is an acute syndrome, distinct from chronic respiratory comorbidities such as COPD.
- The older term "adult respiratory distress syndrome" refers to the same condition; the current term is "acute respiratory distress syndrome".

reviews.comments:
## Summary
**Approved.** Used in QI01 (initial population: ARDS diagnosis).

## Use in our quality indicators
- Used in QI01 (Lung-protective ventilation in ARDS).
- CQL: all 1 concept(s) of the set are referenced in [`IndicateQi01Ventilation.cql`](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/blob/d63eb84a308d5586fcede0b7e3fa73abf6b6761c/cql/IndicateQi01Ventilation.cql?plain=1) ([4195694](https://github.com/umg-minai/cql-indicate-qi/blob/d63eb84a308d5586fcede0b7e3fa73abf6b6761c/cql/IndicateQi01Ventilation.cql?plain=1#L28); each ID links to its code definition).

## Decision trail
- 2026-01-10 · Sebastian Gibb (clinician): First QI01 mapping with Athena IDs; ARDS mapped to the ICD-10 J80 concept 45552897 (today [row ARDS in the QI01 mapping table](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/blob/8014d1e86ebee84856c8163ac1f98e54061cd24b/qi01-ventilation.md?plain=1#L183)). — [QI commit ca86069](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/commit/ca860694d89fe7199cf1c7afc1cffcc62d9c8ce5)
- 2026-03-23 · Gregor Lichtner (interoperability): ARDS changed to SNOMED 4195694 (DD CS 26) because 45552897 is a non-standard OMOP concept; noted in the [QI01 mapping notes](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/blob/8014d1e86ebee84856c8163ac1f98e54061cd24b/qi01-ventilation.md?plain=1#L171). — [QI commits d7409ef, 51353b3](https://github.com/umg-minai/indicate-qi-definitions/commit/d7409ef326f902edb1bf7d9c15edba8ab26655e8)
- 2026-06-12 · Boris Delange (dictionary maintainer): Renamed from "Adult" to "Acute respiratory distress syndrome", description added, moved from draft to pending review; the expression (4195694) is unchanged. — [DD commit 0ac4d70 (CS 26 v1.1.0)](https://github.com/indicate-eu/data-dictionary/commit/0ac4d70face8fb143e1dfd0ccd4bba278f4059af)

## Suggestions
- None.
